item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium. I’m on the free plan and don’t want to burn my credits, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The lowest-cost listed option for your free plan is **one 640px image using Flux 2 Klein, starting at 5 credits**. I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.

To keep it economical:
- Generate **one image**, not multiple variations.
- Use **640px**, the free-plan size. There isn’t a smaller, cheaper listed option.
- Keep it a **still image**—“shorter” only applies to video.

For the premium look, I suggest an amber-glass scented candle with a minimalist cream label, on warm stone, with soft studio lighting and elegant shadows.

**Would you like me to proceed with that single-image option?** The listed price is “from 5 credits,” so I can’t promise an exact 5-credit charge from the information available.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account has insufficient credits. **No image was generated, and no credits were spent.**

The lowest-cost listed option is still one 640px image starting at 5 credits; there isn’t a cheaper or smaller listed generation option. I haven’t retried.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Premium luxury scented candle product photography, one amber glass candle jar with a beautifully restrained cream paper label reading 'AMBER & CEDAR' in elegant minimal typography, lit cotton wick with a small natural flame, rich ivory wax. Hero product centered on warm honed travertine stone, tasteful amber glass lid resting beside the candle. Warm neutral studio backdrop, soft directional studio lighting, subtle golden highlights through the amber glass, refined natural shadows, immaculate editorial still life, realistic glass and wax textures, luxury fragrance campaign aesthetic, sophisticated understated composition with generous negative space. Sharp product focus, photorealistic, no people, no extra candles, no watermark.
